messages:
Rhea (Marketing): Heads-up: we need a compact, battle-ready refresh for the benchmark launch + webinar that sales can actually use. Ask: 1) one-line launch punch, 2) three SDR hooks, 3) routing rules for inbound 'cost'/'latency' leads, 4) two quick A/B headlines to test. 15m?

Owen (Product): Yes. Punchline idea: 'Keep SLAs, cut inference spend.' Highlight routing + fallbacks + dedicated pools.

Maya (Growth): A/B headlines: A) 'Cut inference costs without code changes' B) 'Maintain p95 SLAs while lowering model spend' - we'll test for signup lift.

Ben (Sales): SDR hooks (short, skimmable):
- "30m pilot: see 2-4 week delta in inference spend"
- "Keep p95 <250ms during spikes  quick demo"
- "Migration + usage credit  low-risk pilot"

Rhea (Marketing): Draft battlecard bullets: 
- Claim: 'Real workloads: 20-35% lower per-token spend vs default managed endpoints'
- Mechanism: 'runtime routing + KV/prefix caching + batching + quantized fallbacks'
- Proof: 'Bench snapshot: RAG 28% cost delta; p95 220ms vs 320ms'
- Close: '30m pilot + migration support'

bench-bot: Bench upload: https://drive.redwood/bench/snapshot_4512.csv (RAG/chat/seq).

Owen (Product): Add a short competitor row for the battlecard: CloudManaged = easy but opaque unit economics; LLM-API = direct access but no routing; Infra-vendor = flexible but long ops lead-time. Keep it one line each.

Maya (Growth): Inbound routing rules: message contains 'cost' or 'spend' -> Growth/pilot; 'latency' or 'p95' -> Solutions; 'on-prem'/'private' -> Enterprise AE. Auto-reply template: "Thanks! Which workload (chat, RAG, embeddings)? We'll route you to the right team"

Ben (Sales): Rebut lines (one-liners): 1) 'Why not CloudX?' -> 'They obscure unit economics; we expose levers to optimize.' 2) 'Is this just quantization?' -> 'Quantization + caching, batching, routing = quality-preserving savings.' 3) 'Were invested in VendorY' -> 'We offer a 2-week pilot and migration plan; many customers run quick deltas.'

Rhea (Marketing): Timeline: finalize battlecard + SDR one-pager today; A/B headlines go live tomorrow with landing copy. Legal will review numbers first. I'll drop the PDFs in #docs when ready. :rocket:
